top_choice_rationale: A narrowly defined award to Koenker and Bassett for foundational quantile regression recognizes a mature, broadly consequential methodological breakthrough with an unusually clear discovery and attribution boundary, without claiming credit for later distributional-econometric advances.
recusal_note: I have a long-running collaboration with Peter J. Klenow, a credited name on B023, which is not represented in the proposals. I also have professional coauthor relationships with committee colleagues Per Krusell and John Hassler; neither is a proposed laureate. No connection to the P001 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile.
